about: AGENTSPLACE1a2 (the Agents-place design §4): `daoris place … --plan`'s words, case by case, over PlacePlanTests' stand-in world (solo on its own, engine declaring integration, web on github.com with a landing plugin, docs on gitlab.com with none, atlas not adopted with two queued quests). Each case is the verb's words, its exit code and the lines it prints, PLACE_PLAN's plan said in English from the same code.

cases.name: a repository on its own, merged after you accept, with general driving
lines: place: `solo` — Merge after you accept; general driving
`solo`: now Not driven · after Merge after you accept · suggested Merge after you accept
changes, each said once:
`solo`: a tree per session, off → on
`solo`: a saved copy of the workflow Daoris ships, none → `merge-after-accept`
`solo`: the workflow its work follows, Current → `merge-after-accept`
`solo`: general driving, off → on
--plan: nothing was written, and nothing was asked.

cases.name: two repositories, a pull request refused where no landing plugin serves the remote
lines: place: `web`, `docs` — A pull request
`web`: now 1 change of your own (no workflow is chosen) · after A pull request · suggested Merge after you accept
`docs`: now 1 change of your own (no workflow is chosen) · after 1 change of your own (no workflow is chosen) · suggested Merge after you accept
changes, each said once:
`web`: a saved copy of the workflow Daoris ships, none → `pull-request`
`web`: the workflow its work follows, Current → `pull-request`
refused:
- `docs`'s remote is on `gitlab.com`, and no landing plugin here opens a pull request there: a pull request is its platform's plugin's to open. Add one on Plugins, or choose *A branch to push*.

cases.name: neither --plan nor --apply is the usage
lines: place: name `--plan` to read the plan, or `--apply` to apply it.

usage: daoris place <repository>… --preset <id> [--with opinion,look] [--adoption [--what-it-builds <kind>] [--at-once <n>] [--pilot <n>]] [--drive] (--plan | --apply [--accept <repository>:landed|integration,…])
daoris place --workspace <name> --adoption [--plan] [--at-once <n>] [--pilot <n>] [--first <repo>…] [--skip <repo>…]
daoris place --workspace <name> --pause | --resume | --stop
